I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss; to begin our assessment, how long have these symptoms been present and have you noticed any fever or night sweats?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, TSH, ESR/CRP.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: COMPLETE BLOOD COUNT: WBC Elevated with lymphocytosis, Hemoglobin Normal to slightly decreased, Platelets Normal to decreased. COMPREHENSIVE METABOLIC PANEL: Not available in current data. TSH: Not available in current data. ESR/CRP: Not available in current data. ADDITIONAL FINDINGS: Flow Cytometry indicates presence of monoclonal B lymphocytes with a phenotype consistent with CLL/SLL. Physical Exam reveals chronic illness appearance, bilateral cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy, and splenomegaly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL).

The blood work confirms elevated lymphocytes with a monoclonal B-cell population, and the physical exam finding of generalized lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly is classic for this condition. I will now request flow cytometry images to confirm the specific immunophenotype before finalizing your treatment plan.
